This list is a major update of the original 1953 GSL list (which only covers about 80%) and is being adopted by a growing number of publishers, companies and online tools for learning, teaching and analyzing text.  A fuller discussion of the NGSL including published research can be found at our dedicated website  (www.newgeneralservicelist.org).
